Amazon’s eCommerce Foundation (eCF) organization is responsible for the core components that drive the Amazon website and customer experience. Serving millions of customer page views and orders per day, eCF builds for scale. As an organization within eCF, the Business Data Technologies (BDT) group is no exception. We also support Amazon subsidiaries such as IMDB and Audible. We build scalable solutions that grow with Amazon’s business.  

  

BDT is growing, and the data processing landscape is shifting. Our data is consumed by thousands of teams across Amazon including Research Scientists, Machine Learning Specialists, Business Analysts and Data Engineers.  

  

We are developing innovative products including the next\-generation of data catalog, data discovery engine, data transformation, machine learning, and more with AWS technologies.  

  

We're looking for talented engineers to build them from the ground up.
  

  

This is a hands\-on position where you will design and build extremely scalable components and features for data processing at Amazon. You will work closely with senior engineers to solve challenging technical problems and collaborate with internal customers to help them get the best results. You should be a strong software developer with solid programming skills, an understanding of data structures and algorithms, and a passion for massive\-scale computing. A desire to learn, deliver results, and grow as an engineer is essential.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Collaborate with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, develop, and deliver innovative products and services.
* Design and build software components in a large distributed computing environment.
* Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
* Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault\-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
* Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Work in an agile environment to deliver high\-quality software.
* Write clean, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews.
